The clip opens exactly on <Picture 1>: a backlit wide aerial vertical 9:16 view of the Dunhuang desert sand dunes and crescent spring, the low sun gilding the golden dune ridges while a caravan of camels moves as silhouettes along the crest. Dune shapes, spring, backlight and caravan placement stay consistent with the image. Over the four seconds the camera arcs slowly with small amplitude around the ridge while easing in with a gentle push, so the silhouetted camels progress steadily along the dune line and the warm rim light shifts across the sand. Soft, natural diffuse backlight, neutral warm-white in the shadows, bright and airy, not oppressive, no heavy amber wash over the whole frame; true-to-life photographic quality with fine natural grain, real matte surfaces, no plastic or waxy CG look. Any figures on the camels read only as small distant silhouettes. No text, subtitles, letters, numbers, watermark, logo, brand, signage or road signs anywhere in the frame.
